evidence.original_label: 低能大束流离子注入机客户已突破11家
evidence.excerpt: 2024 年，凯世通获得 3 家头部客户批量重复订单，并新增开拓 2 家新客户订单。截至报告期末，凯世通的主要产品在客户销售方面取得显著成果：低能大束流离子注入机客户已突破 11 家；超低温离子注入机客户突破 7 家；高能离子注入机客户也突破 2 家。
evidence.review_notes: Re-sweep of a page in a registered original that earlier extraction never opened. Extracted by one agent and independently verified by a separate agent that reopened the original page rather than the extractor summary.

notes: Customers of Kingstone's LOW-ENERGY HIGH-CURRENT ion implanter line (低能大束流离子注入机) at FY2024 period end. 突破 / 已突破 is a lower bound and is NOT converted to a point value: relation is gt and the native figure is carried in evidence.reported_value. Point-in-time base stated 截至报告期末 (as of the end of the reporting period). No calendar date is printed in the clause, so the period end is taken as the filing's own reporting-period end — 2024-12-31 — and nothing further is invented. metric customer_count carries time_base as_of, hence period.kind as_of / basis as_of. Subject named explicitly in the surrounding MD&A section as 公司旗下控股子公司凯世通, so attributed to kingstone_semiconductor and not to the listed parent (Wanye Enterprises / Xiandao Jidian), whose FY2024 reporting also covers the sibling equipment subsidiary 嘉芯半导体 and a run-off property business. Per-product-line customer counts overlap: one fab can appear in several product lines, and the issuer never states they are disjoint. They must NOT be summed, and the sum must not be compared with the whole-company cumulative customer base (H126-KS-CUST = 16 customers at as_of 2026-06-30, scope kingstone_generic_implant_operating_milestones, category implant). The product-line rows sit in their own per-line scopes and categories, so they do not collide with that row or with each other. Series: this is the earliest of three observations of the same line (>11 at 2024-12-31, >12 at 2025-12-31, >14 at 2026-06-30). Restated verbatim in the chairman's letter at physical p.3 of the same filing; one row only, anchored on the MD&A page, and independent_corroboration stays false because both mentions are the same issuer document.

evidence.original_label: 全年实现10多台12英寸离子注入机设备交付
evidence.excerpt: （1）交付量增速：全年实现 10 多台 12 英寸离子注入机设备交付，覆盖了低能大束流、超低温等多类机型，部分设备实现当年交付当年验收，验收周期大幅缩短。
evidence.review_notes: Re-sweep of a page in a registered original that earlier extraction never opened. Extracted by one agent and independently verified by a separate agent that reopened the original page rather than the extractor summary.

notes: FY2025 full-year deliveries of 12-inch ion implanters by Kingstone. 10 多台 is a LOWER BOUND ('ten-odd', more than 10) and is preserved as relation gt with value 10 — it is NOT converted to a point value of 10, and NOT rounded up to 12 or any other guess. Unit 台 -> system. Scope is the approved kingstone_12inch_implant_annual_operating_milestones because the clause carries an explicit 12 英寸 qualifier and an explicit full-financial-year window: kingstone_generic_implant_operating_milestones forbids attaching a 12-inch qualifier and here the qualifier IS present; kingstone_12inch_implant_cumulative_milestones is a 2020年至今 cumulative perimeter; kingstone_12inch_implant_h1_operating_milestones is H1-only. This ANNUAL FLOW must not be read against either of those two: it is not comparable to the cumulative >55 deliveries (H126-KS-CUMSHIP) or 60 cumulative 12-inch orders (WANYE2024-KS-ORDERS), and not to the H1 2026 6-system half-year flow (H126-KS-SHIP). Delivery (交付) is distinct from acceptance (验收): the same filing separately reports FY2025 acceptances of >15 implanters (RESWEEP-E-KINGSTONE-FY2025-P22-ACCEPTANCES), which is a wider, non-12-inch-qualified perimeter and legitimately exceeds this figure. Mix disclosed as 覆盖了低能大束流、超低温等多类机型 (low-energy high-current, cryogenic and other types) — collective across product lines, so the row stays at category implant and is not split per line. Restated at physical p.3 and, as 已实现交付 10 多台 12 英寸离子注入机, at p.22.
